caption: Allen & Ginter, Cranberry, from the Fruits series (N12), a cigarette card (1891)
alt: A small colour-printed card: a child's face in a white ruffled bonnet with pink ribbons, beside a sprig of cranberry with small leaves and red berries tied with an orange ribbon; below, “Cranberry.”
bibliography: Allen & Ginter. Cranberry, from the Fruits series (N12) for Allen & Ginter Cigarettes Brands. 1891, commercial colour lithograph, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, The Jefferson R. Burdick Collection, 63.350.201.12.13.
title: Cranberry, from the Fruits series (N12) for Allen & Ginter Cigarettes Brands
